replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, frequently. My high neuroticism means I get anxious easily, especially with math. The pressure to understand complex concepts makes me stressed, even though I know it's important.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I tried an AI tutor for algebra. It was helpful for step-by-step solutions, but I still struggled with the abstract concepts. It reduced some anxiety, though.
replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: First, write it as ax² + bx + c = 0. Calculate discriminant (b²-4ac). If positive, use quadratic formula: x = [-b ± √(discriminant)] / 2a. If zero, one solution: -b/2a. If negative, no real solutions.

Find where the derivative of f(x) equals zero. First, calculate f'(x). Set f'(x)=0 and solve for x. These x-values are critical points. To check if they’re stationary points, take the second derivative f''(x). If f''(x)>0, it’s a minimum; if <0, a maximum.
